prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic raw DSLR paparazzi-style portrait inside a beige leather private-jet cabin.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with natural unstyled hair and realistic unretouched skin, wearing a white graphic T-shirt, black leather cross-body strap, silver chain, small hoop earring, and optional authentic tattoos on forearms.
prompt.composition_elements: Tight waist-up crop from the aisle, slightly high angle, subject leaning casually forward with glasses and a wide rebellious grin, hands raised in a non-threatening expressive gesture, blurred beige seats and indistinct figures behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh natural cabin light mixed with overhead light, uneven exposure, gritty contrast, mild blown highlights, documentary paparazzi energy, subtle grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic DSLR look, shallow depth of field, organic lens falloff, film-like RAW processing, natural proportions, imperfect framing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic raw DSLR paparazzi-style cinematic portrait of an approved adult woman inside a beige leather private-jet cabin. Use a tight waist-up crop from the aisle, slightly high-angle perspective, natural unstyled hair, realistic unretouched skin with pores and fine imperfections, thin oval metal-frame glasses, and a wide rebellious grin. She wears a white graphic T-shirt, black leather cross-body strap, silver chain necklace, small hoop earring, and optional authentic forearm tattoos. Both hands are lifted near the chest in an expressive non-threatening gesture. Blurred beige seats and indistinct figures sit behind her. Use harsh natural cabin light mixed with overhead lighting, gritty contrast, mild blown highlights, organic blur, subtle grain, and documentary RAW authenticity.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized gesture, hate gesture, graphic violence, nudity, beauty filter, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
